entryTemplates.empty: No templates yet. Templates pre-fill a new entry's properties, making entries you create often quicker to add.

confirmation.title: Delete template
confirmation.message: The template will be permanently deleted. Entries created from it are not affected.
confirmation.messageWithFiles: The template and its stored files will be permanently deleted. Entries created from it are not affected.

properties.description: You can customise properties after creating the database.

errors.nameConflict: A database with this name already exists.
errors.pathConflict: A folder with this name already exists in the at the specified location.

settings.description: Defaults applied to newly created databases and to content dropped or pasted into the app.

contentDefaults.description: Content dropped or pasted into the app is added to the database picked for its type. Files of no listed type are added to the other files database.

name.description: The name used to identify this database.

entryName.description: The label used when referring to a single entry.

icon.description: The icon shown next to this database.

entryOpenMode.label: Open entries as
entryOpenMode.description: Choose the default action for opening entries.

dialog.label: Dialog
dialog.description: Open the entry as a dialog overlay.

panel.label: Panel
panel.description: Open the entry in a slide out panel.

inPlace.label: In place
inPlace.description: Replace the current view with the entry.

newTab.label: New tab
newTab.description: Open the entry in a new tab.

split.label: Split view
split.description: Open the entry next to the current main content.

hideViewsToolbar.label: Hide views toolbar
hideViewsToolbar.description: Hide the bar for switching and adding views. Useful when the database only has a single view.

entrySerializer.label: Entry file format
entrySerializer.description: Choose the file format entries are saved in on disk.

propertyFileStorage.label: Property file storage
propertyFileStorage.description: Choose how files added to properties are stored on disk.

root.label: Database root
root.description: Files are kept in the database's root folder.

common.label: Common folder
common.description: Files are kept together in a single shared folder.

property.label: Folder per property
property.description: Files are grouped into a folder for each property.

entry.label: Folder per entry
entry.description: Files are grouped into a folder for each entry.

propertyFilesDir.label: Property files folder
propertyFilesDir.description: The name of the common folder property files are stored in.

delete.description: Deleting this database will move all of its content to the system trash.

confirmation.title: Delete database
confirmation.message: Are you sure you want to delete this database? This action cannot be undone.

clear.title: Clear database
clear.description: Delete all entries in this database. The database and its configuration are kept.

confirmation.title: Clear database
confirmation.message: Are you sure you want to delete all entries in this database? This action cannot be undone.

empty.title: No entries yet
empty.addViaButton: Click the + button at the top right to add a new entry.
empty.drop: You can also drop text, files, and links.

blank.description: Start from scratch with just a title, created date, and last modified date. You can add more properties after creating the database.

design.noDesigns: No designs yet. Create one in design mode.
design.empty: No designs yet. Add one with the + button.

confirmation.title: Delete design
confirmation.message: Are you sure you want to delete this design? This cannot be undone.

defaultDesigns.title: Default designs
defaultDesigns.description: The designs used to display the database's entries in each context. Individual views can override these defaults with a specific design.

entryColor.title: Entry colour
entryColor.description: The property entries take their colour from: the Colour property, or a select property's option colours.
entryColor.label: Colour entries by

confirmation.message: This will remove it from all database items and can't be undone.
